RecordLabel.Name: Black Hole Recordings
RecordLabel.LabelDescription:
Owned by [a=DJ Tiësto] and [a=Arny Bink].
      Black Hole Recordings was founded in the fall of 1997. Well-known as the company of DJ Tiësto and his Magik and Space Age compilation series, Black Hole started to release their own magikal stories on vinyl.
      
      Company also had a record-store named [b]Magik: The Record Store[/b] which was located at Nieuwstraat 46 in Breda, but it closed down in 2006. The shop's logo was the same as the first editions of the Magik mix compilations.

RecordLabel.Name: Armada Music
RecordLabel.LabelDescription:
Independent Dutch company founded in June 2003 by [a=Armin van Buuren], [a=Maykel Piron] & David Lewis.
      
      "Armada" was formed by utilizing the first two letters in each of the founding members names.
      
      Vinyl-distribution by [l=Astral Music]
      CD-distribution by [l=Zomba/BMG]

RecordLabel.Name: Anjunabeats
RecordLabel.LabelDescription:
UK Trance label, established in 2000 by [a=Above & Beyond].
      
      [b]Format guidelines:[/b]
      CDr's were manufactured on demand, so the packaging varied as well. Therefore, a different sleeve alone does not qualify for a unique release.
      
      The packaging variants for CDr's are
      - white Anjunabeats cardboard sleeve with sticker
      - plastic sleeve
      - release-specific cardboard sleeve
      - grey Anjunabeats cardboard sleeve
      - blue Anjunabeats cardboard sleeve (promos with sticker)
      
      Contact info: 
      Anjunabeats
      PO Box 35234
      London
      E1 2WA
      United Kingdom
      
      Tel/Fax: +44-(0)20-7702 7954

RecordLabel.Name: Masters Of Hardcore
RecordLabel.LabelDescription:
Dutch Gabber-label.

Home of [a=DJ Outblast] (label) & [a=King Matthew] (party).

Masters of Hardcore was born at 1996 in the Hemkade in Zaandam (NL). Presenting the best of the best in hardcore, they made her name true. 
Also the label Masters of Hardcore released her first records around that time. 
The first release was from the USA The nr.1 hardcore deejay from the States [a=Rob Gee] teamed up with [a=DJ J.D.A.] with the result [r=94293].

Around 1998 the hardcore scene in the Netherlands reached her lowest point. 
The major labels where no longer interested in hardcore music and the big event promoters choose to organize more common dance music, such as trance and club. 
Many hardcore producers and deejays didn't know what to do and the die-hard hardcore fans didn't know where to go.

Masters of Hardcore started to organize their parties as an independent and [a=Bass-D & King Matthew] decided to continue to produce hardcore music on the Masters of Hardcore label.

Their first party was completely sold out and from that moment on hardcore could breath again. 
[a=Bass-D & King Matthew] teamed up with [a=DJ Buzz Fuzz], [a=DJ Paul] and [a=Masochist, The] and the Masters of Hardcore label became more popular then ever.

Masters of Hardcore has grown to be one of the most popular hardcore concepts of the world.

People from all around the globe are coming to the Netherlands to be a withness of the famous Masters of Hardcore parties. 
After the Hemk48e in Zaandam, Masters of Hardcore is now organized in bigger locations all over the Netherlands. 
Such as The Beursgebouw in Eindhoven and the PBH-Hallen in Zuidlaren, where over 20.000 hardcorefreaks come together.

Masters of Hardcore is still on the move to get the hardcore scene to a higher level. 
With new producers and new deejays and with a cd-compilation series that sells world-wide over 200.000 pieces.

As long as the die-hard crowd is there, Masters of Hardcore will continue to bring the harder sounds to you.

RecordLabel.Name: The Third Movement
RecordLabel.LabelDescription:
In the year 2001 [a=Sebastian Hoff] (a.k.a. [a=Promo]) and [a=Martijn Mobron] (a.k.a. [a=DJ X-ess]), friends and colleges at ID&T started their own company and label: "The Third Movement".

One of the main reasons Hoff and Mobron started their own independent record-company was because they had enough after an argument with the managers at ID&T during the release of Promo’s 6th Promo File. Because of that the licensing of the Promo Files swapped half way from ID&T to The Third Movement you will find a half and split-up catalogue for the Promo File series.

Promo File 1 - 6 are located in the [l=ID&T] catalogue (rights and licensing ID&T) and Promo File 7 – 10B at The Third Movement Label (rights and licensing The Third Movement)
Licensing of File 1 – 6 is owned by ID&T, it’s not from Promo as a lot of people think, licensing of the Promo File 7 – 10B is owned by The Third Movement. The Promo File 1 - 6 have been repressed in november 2005 and re-released on The Third Movement Label.

The label has been focussing on creative output, giving new artists a chance to experiment and test their style.

[u]Sublabels:[/u]
[l=Men In Motion] Techno, management by [a=Innerdrive].
[l=Danamite] Hardstyle, management by [a=Dana].
[l=Stealth Industries] Hardtrance & hardstyle, management by [a=Tommy Pulse].
[l=Industrial Movement] Industrial hardcore, set up together with [l=Industrial Strength Records], management by [a=Lenny Dee] & [a=Promo].

[u]Series[/u]
[b]r_AW[/b] Rude Awakening's release series
[b]Promo File[/b] Promo's first own series, from File 007 a part of The Third Movement
[b]Promo Type[/b] The follow up label from the well known Promo Files
[b]Demolition[/b] Series covering the Demolition CD (and Vinyl Sampler) releases.
[b]Catscan LTD[/b] Catscan LTD, followed up on [l=Pro Artist Management]

Some of the early The Third Movement releases are "missing" in the catalog listing, since they were released on other labels. Don't add these "missing" releases to the The Third Movement catalog, since they do not have The Third Movement catalog numbers.

The following releases are "missing":
T3RDM-00002 was released on [l=Samurai Records] as SAMU 023 ([r=32535]).
T3RDM-00007 was released on [l=Bzrk Records] as BZRK 026 ([r=23850]).
T3RDM-00015 was released on [l=Bzrk Records] as BZRK 031 ([r=23852]).

RecordLabel.LabelDescription:
Mike Shiver joined forces in early 2004 with Johan Bergström to form the Trance label Captured Music, as a part of [l=Monster Tunes].

RecordLabel.Name: Blue Trance Records
RecordLabel.LabelDescription: Teppo Herttuainen and Timo Pitkänen, the masterminds behind Blue Trance Records, are no strangers to the music industry. They both have been creating and mastering music for over a decade. The label was established in January 2009 with their first release, Bluebear Project - Nowhere To Go. Since then, they have released music from other artists such as Caira, Lumberjack, Braincreator and Taleamus. The label is known for its high-quality productions and masterpieces. Every release is a work of art that is sure to take the listener on a journey.
RecordLabel.LabelLaunchMessage:
A new digital trance label has been established by Teppo Herttuainen.

Description from the man himself:
      
Blue Trance Records is an independent Finnish record label founded in early 2009 by Teppo Herttuainen from Bluebear Project. Our objectives are releasing high-quality trance music, be a top trance label in the world and find new talents.
      
      Nowadays there are many labels which get lost in the mass. So we want to differ from the mass. Our strengths are good togetherness, cheerful atmosphere and lovely people.
      
      If you want to join our great team please feel free to contact us. It's so simple! We are always looking for new talents.

RecordLabel.Name: ID&T
RecordLabel.LabelDescription:
Founded by [b]I[/b]rfan van Ewijk, [b]D[/b]uncan Stutterheim and [b]T[/b]heo Lelie (= I, D & T) 

It all started out as these three guys organizing a post-Graduation party “The Final Exam” in 1992 in Utrecht. After this first big success, they organised a lot more party events such as Thunderdome, Mystery Land and Global Hardcore Nation. At the end of the ninetees however, Hardcore and Gabber music became less popular and ID&T (who employed over 50 people at that time) decided to abbandon their traditional musicstyle. In 1999 they organised Innercity in Amsterdam, an indoor event without hardcore music.

The company went trough some changes the last couple of years. The label ID&T is now owned by [i]Be Yourself Music[/i], and they sold their publishing company too. In order to stay in the music business they started Dance-Tunes.com, one of the largest legal download portal in The Netherlands nowadays. In January 2005, radio station ID&T Radio was renamed to SLAM FM, with more commercially focused music. A few months later it was sold to 2HMedia.

Today, ID&T is still a major dance organizer in The Netherlands, Belgium and abroad. Some well-known events: Thunderdome, Mystery Land, Innercity, Trance Energy and Sensation. 

You can read more about this label in the book “Release – 10 Years of ID&T.”   There is also a documentary about this label called "God Is A DJ".

For the 1st logo they used a french graffiti as inspiration.

RecordLabel.Name: Kaktai Records
RecordLabel.LabelDescription:
Kaktai Records is a legendary Brighton based Hard House / NRG label owned & run by Superfast Oz & Dom Sweeten. The label sports huge releases & remixes from a longstanding & very successful collaboration between the duo as OD404, as well as a number of solo & colloborative efforts by both Oz and Dom (under his Defective Audio & Base Graffiti aliases).
      
      Dom and Oz met whilst DJ'ing at gigs in Brighton during the mid 90's. They had similiar tastes and both were interested in dabbling with music production, so they aquired some studio equiment and started crafting their art. Very few labels were initially interested and the duo later launched Kaktai Records in '97 as a platform for their music.
      
      Kaktai Records has since seen outstanding appearences by some of the most renowned artists in the Hard House / NRG arena, making it one of the most consistent & supported labels in the scene.

RecordLabel.Name: Vicious Circle Recordings
RecordLabel.LabelDescription:
Vicious Circle Recordings is a paramount UK Hard House / NRG label established by [a=Paul Glazby] and Les Harris in 2000 & since then joined by [a=Ben Stevens], [a=Tim Clewz] & Kate Hammond. The latter joining VC after the departure of label manager [a=Scott Cooper] who went on pursuing a career outside of the music industry.
      
      The list of underground anthems & classics produced by a legion of esteemed artists appearing on the label, has ensured a large & loyal following stretching across the globe. The label launched the "[b]I Love VC[/b]" brand on July 30th 2005 with an event at [i]The Fridge[/i] in London along with an album titled by the same name. The idea was initially for a T-shirt design but Glazby thought the logo to be so "[i]iconic[/i]" that the album and event took on the same name. "[i]I Love VC[/i] [is] [i]an event, it's merchandise and itÂ’s a statement of just how the people at Vicious Circle are feeling ...[/i]"
      
      Five years, forty releases, a slight change in direction for the label along the way & a long absence from top dog Paul Glazby appearing on his own label (only one collaboration and two remixes in the second twenty releases), he took on Kate Hammond's concept of writing "[b]The 10 Commandments[/b]", which was launched in conjunction with the "I Love VC" campaign. The project involved either producing an original track or a remix spanning over ten releases that aimed to put Glazby back on his imprint and steer Vicious Circle into the direction they had envisioned for the label. The highlight of course being the last "Commandment" ... the 50th release. A 2005 Paul Glazby rework of the classic and highly celebrated track that initiated the Vicious Circle adventure ... "[i]Kick It[/i]".

RecordLabel.Name: Recharge
RecordLabel.LabelDescription:
Recharge is a UK Hard House label founded by [a=Simon Eve] and React Music in 2000.
      
      The label is home to several leading hard dance producers, such as Weirdo, DMF and ofcourse Simon Eve and have sported big guns such as Paul Glazby, Defective Audio, OD404, Justin Bourne, Dave Randall, Marc Johnson and more. 
      
      When Simon Eve moved to become A&R and label manager at EVE Records in 2002 he took the Recharge imprint with him to continue the early success of the label, and at the start of 2004 Simon set up a separate company, Recharge Limited, to look after all the day to day runnings of the label. Today, Recharge stands as one of the most successful and respected independent hard dance labels in the world.
      
      [B]Also written as Recharge Recordings on some releases.[/B]

RecordLabel.Name: Tripoli Trax
RecordLabel.LabelDescription:
This absolutely legendary Hard House label was launched in the 1994 from within the [b]Puregroove Records[/b] store in London, England by [url=http://www.discogs.com/artist/DJ+Ziad]Ziad[/url], his brother Tarik & [a=Mick Shiner]. It became instrumental in the development of UK Hard House & Nu NRG during the late 90's and by the turn of the millenium, Tripoli Trax reached its acme with a large number of classic releases and remixes by just about every heavyweight in the scene.
      
      As of the 100th release in April 2004, [a=Marc Johnson] took over as A&R from [a=Steve Hill] who steered the label into Hard Trance territory since the end of 2001.  Marc succeeded to inject a refreshing energy into the label with releases by a different breed of producers as well as bringing some of the Tripoli's old guard back into the fold, thus delivering the toughest sounds in Hard House & NRG once again.
      
      At the end of 2005 Pure Groove made a decision to put Tripoli Trax on hold indefinitely, do away with Hard Dance sales at their stores and concentrate on a soaring Indie market. The label's hibernation lasted nearly two years when in 2007 [a=Marc Johnson] once again took charge of this classic imprint with the assistance of [a=Chris Comben].
      
      The label closed doors again for good in 2008 when Marc Johnson retired from Djing and producing.

RecordLabel.Name: Streamline Records
RecordLabel.LabelDescription:
Streamline Studios, an independent game developer and leading digital content provider for AAA videogames, and Black Hole Recordings, a leading electronic music record label, announced today the formation of Streamline Sound, a joint venture dedicated to providing sound solutions for digital entertainment.
      
      Streamline Sound combines Streamline’s existing audio services and 5.1 studio with the entire artist roster and catalog of Black Hole Recordings, including Grammy-nominated electronic music superstar Tiësto, as well as a large number of independent composers and musicians.
      
      Streamline Records, the leading label for game music, today announced a 67 percent increase over 2007, in companies using its game music and audio production services through Streamline Records and it’s audio production brand, Streamline Sound. The increase has been driven by original soundtracks and music including the Alone in the Dark, DJ Tiësto tracks and Granado Espada’s deep and moving audioscape, as well as Streamline Sound’s growing studio work in setting the mood and tone of numerous releases throughout 2008.
      
      Atari recently announced Streamline Record’s newest original soundtrack for the highly-anticipated Alone in the Dark. Streamline Records recording artist and #1 ranked DJ in the world, DJ Tiësto created new electronic soul pumping music that is also featured in the world’s first videogame music video. Additional projects will be announced over the coming months as Streamline Records reveals its goal to change the way music for games is perceived and thought about from an artistic perspective. Game music can transcend games.

RecordLabel.Name: Dreamteam Productions
RecordLabel.LabelDescription:
Shortly after ID&T was founded back in 1992 the company decided to give the successful Dreamteam members their own label after their immense popular live appearances. This lead to the first music label from ID&T Music, started in the beginning of 1993 which was meant for productions of "The Dreamteam" members only; DJ Buzz Fuzz, The Prophet, DJ Dano & DJ Gizmo. 

ID&T did their own marketing, design and publishing. Publishing was done in collaboration with Ratel Music. Also  ID&T Music Germany was founded for German distributing, marketing, and licensing to other companies such as "Streetheat Music". Mid-town Rotterdam provided the worldwide distrubutions of all ID&T releases. When the label started it used a "DREAM" catalogue first but after 8 releases they changed the catalogue into "DTP". Eventually ID&T stopped releasing on the label in 1997 when the hardcore hype was over. Defunct since then.

Dutch Happy Hardcore-label from ID&T. Defunkt since 1997. Pengo Records was managed by Dov Elkabas also known as DJ The Prophet from the ID&T Dreamteam. Nowadays Dov owns and runs his own labels under the name of Scantraxx, releasing hardstyle.

As taken from the Thunderdome X booklet :
Pengo Records.
One year ago thousands of penguins came to Holland to buy a new kind of icecream which was very popular at that time. After the icecream was sold out all penguins returned to Antartica except for one fluffy little one called Pengo. This bird went to some clubs and accidentally got hooked on dancing to the beat of house music. Later that month he paid a visit to ID&T Music to discuss his possibilities as label manager, but while he was reading the last episode of strobe magazine he suddenly collapsed due to the weather that was obviously too hot for a penguin.  It was impossible for him to move any of his feet or wings, and so the DJ's at ID&T Music had to fix him with a new mechanism to make it possible for him to dance again. Everybody knows of course that penguins are allergic to battery acid and so the DJ's made sure they could wind up his mechanism with a large key which they connected through his back. 

Nowadays Pengo is a happy bird and a successful label manager, his first release is produced exclusively for him by Critical Mass, immediatly followed by an EP from DJ Weirdo & DJ Sim. The bird nation also expects some stuff from DJ's like E-Rick & Tactic, Scott Brown, The Dreamteam and all other friends Pengo met the last couple of months ...

RecordLabel.Name: Ruffneck Records
RecordLabel.LabelDescription:
Founded by [a=Patrick van Kerckhoven] (aka [a=DJ Ruffneck]) as a home for his own unique sound, which would later come to be known as 'artcore'. The intent was to bring breakbeat hardcore to the Netherlands, but not everyone fully understood this. Breakbeats have always played a very important part in all releases on the label and combined with tearing Juno synths and heavily distorted kick drums it has left its permanent impression on the entire hardcore scene. XSV were the financial backers, but in reality all A&R, and other duties, were handled by Patrick van Kerckhoven.

At the end of 1997 van Kerckhoven sued XSV Music to claim the rights of Ruffneck. The court decided the music belonged to van Kerckhoven but the licensing of the logo was in the hands, and stayed in the hands of XSV Music. Without the music XSV had a worthless logo and decided to put it on sale. ID&T hesitated and eventually George Russeler, from Rige Entertainment, bought the logo and exploited it for commercial reasons; merchandising for t-shirts, slipmats and so on.
Van Kerckhoven, frustrated as he was, continued releasing his music on a new label he called "[l=Gangsta Audiovisuals]". The Ruffneck label could not be used since the logos weren't his. This lead to a kind of listing where the Gangsta Audiovisuals catalogue numbers continue where Ruffneck Records ended (RUF 049-2). The first release on the Gangsta label (G 50-5) was called "The Quest For Justice", and this showed Van Kerckhovens frustration about the court's decision. The new logo of the Gangsta Audiovisuals label was an update of the old Ruffneck logo, created by Patrick Moerland.
RecordLabel.LabelDefunctAnnouncement: Due to legal disputes over the Ruffneck logo with XSV music, Patrick van Kerckhoven is shutting down Ruffneck Records. The artcore alliance is still going strong and shall be back in one form or another!

So many sacrifices is the a-track on this record. The dramatic breakdown will definitely cause some goose bumps on your body! The b-side starts of with ‘ The Chosen’. This is a melodic solo track by Ophidian. The arrangement of this track is unbelievable. Take your time to listen to this one! GeneratedRelease.Title: Enemy Of The State II - A Mind Less Ordinary
GeneratedRelease.ReleaseNotes:
After years of hard work, Nosferatu can proudly present his second album: Enemy of the State II. In 2001 he shocked the entire world with his first Enemy of the State album on Gangsta Audiovisuals. The tracks on this classic hardcore album were played by virtually every self-respecting hardcore DJ in the world. You’ll still hear these tracks played by many DJs today.

His new album on Enzyme Records will be released as a double 12”. Both slices of Enzyme 28 contain 4 brand-new Nosferatu tracks. After some careful deliberation he decided not to put any collaborations on this album. You won't find any remixes on this album, either. All tracks are 100% Nosferatu.

Nosferatu created a very versatile album this time around. Naturally it contains some stunning melodic party tracks with which he once again proves that he is one of the best mainstream producers around. In addition to these dancefloor hits you’ll also see Nosferatu showcase his darker side on this album. He managed to create some amazingly creepy atmosphere in some of these tracks. And last but not least the man gives us some up-tempo hardcore tracks for those who like it fast.

In short Nosferatu delivers a very well-rounded album with Enemy of the State II. A hardcore album you cannot afford to miss!

RecordLabel.Name: Outland Records
RecordLabel.LabelDescription:
Outland records started of in 1991 as a label of the famous Amsterdam record store Outland Records.
Together with Outland Records (club orientated) also a label called Spiritual Records (techno orientated) was born. Both labels used the same catnumbers, starting with "trip". Outland Records used the trip 0xx serie, where Spiritual Records was catalogued with trip 1xx.

Famous for its Dadara sleeves, and excellent techno tracks, Outland was soon wanted all over the world. Unfortunately and due to internal problems under management of the first owner, the labels went bankrupt in the summer of 1997. Here fore original releases on Outland records are worth a lot of money these days. 

In 1999 the labels were taken over by Rhythm Import in The Hague. They also started with a new cat# serie OUTxxx for Outland Records and SPRxxx for Spiritual Records. Rhythm Import went bankrupt in 2003, which was also the end of both labels.

As from summer 2005 Jeroen Krom (a.k.a. dj Jerome) is officially owner of Outland Records. A new record together with Jamie Anderson introduces the new Outland sound.

GeneratedRelease.Title: Far Beyond
GeneratedRelease.ReleaseNotes: Ektoplazm is proud to present Far Beyond, the full-length debut of Farbo (Fabián Arturo Jiménez Gally), a Mexican psytrance producer and talented graphic artist. Written over the course of two years, this album twists and shimmers with light and colour, blending mystical progressive grooves with intricate morning melodies and full-on dance floor energy. Remaining true to one of the core concepts of psychedelic trance, Far Beyond is designed to arouse an inner awareness of the connectedness of all things. Mastered and designed by the artist; view more of his work at farboart.com.

GeneratedRelease.Title: Darjeeling Express
GeneratedRelease.ReleaseNotes: The notorious Disco Hooligans (Nectarios Meidanis & Jordan Bonyo) return with their eagerly-awaited sophomore album, Darjeeling Express. Since thundering onto the international stage with last year’s Clear Skies, their impressive debut album, Jordan and Nectarios have been hard at work refining their upbeat and life-affirming brand of psychedelic trance. The result is an exhilarating blend of full-on energy and progressive grooviness distinguished by big beats, fat bass lines, and crystal clear melodies. Hop aboard and take a ride on the Darjeeling Express! Mastered by Colin Bennun at the Stooodio, Bristol, UK, with cover artwork by Amalia Makri.

GeneratedRelease.Title: Creatures Of The Forest
GeneratedRelease.ReleaseNotes: Ektoplazm is proud to present Creatures Of The Forest, the eagerly anticipated second album by Canadian psytrance producer Ekoplex (Ray Vincent). Following the immense underground success of Journey Of The Turtle, his full-length debut in 2008, Ekoplex returned to his Toronto studio to undertake the evolution of his unique brand of full-on psychedelic morning trance. Now, after nearly two years of intensive work and brazen experimentation, it is time to share the results with the world! Creatures Of The Forest is a seamlessly mixed journey into the heart of the forest ecosystem, where all life is interconnected and the ancient spirit of nature is revealed. This album features vocals by Adam Aves and Viki Ebadi, mastering by Jay Kerner (Southwild), and cover art by Rompfndasl of Neuromantix.

RecordLabel.Name: Millennium Records
RecordLabel.LabelDescription:
Founded by [a=Bent Recknagel] and [a=Ralph P. Ruppert]

From the booklet of [r=135325]:
Formed in 1993 during the high excitement of Techno, the label delivered slamming club classics and banging anthems. The first release, "Head-Doctor", was produced by none other than Londoner Ray Shulman of Sugar Cubes fame. Innovative international top acts like Oliver Lieb aka. Genetix and the fabulous East London based Electronic freak Jon Ryman swiftly followed.

Then came Friends, Lovers & Family, aka. Planetoid and original underground classics like D.A.V.E. The  Drummer's "Dr. Octopus" along with banging House artists The Messiah aka. Atomic.

In 1996, Millenium Records established such pioneering compilation series as the cult sampler "A Nite At Strawberry Sundae" (one of the best Clubs London ever has produced... for those who were there... you know), the UK Space Techno series as well as the ever selling Chill-Out sampler "Techno Ballads". The spiralling influence of Drum & Bass is reflected in the brilliant "Atmospheric Drum & Bass" series, mixed by Aphrodite & DJ Wild Child, which is still one of the best selling titles.

Throughout the years, Millenium Records has s served up a rare dish of new talent that has been carefully selected and ingeniously mastered. Max Reich from Sweden delivered three full length albums, launching himself into the forefront of Northern Electro Acid artists. The Starseeds, a mind-blowing mixture of dreamy Trip-Hop meets Enya, was critically acclaimed by the British press and rated as "the hottest import since Massive Attack" by the US Billboard magazine. Their two Albums "Parallel Life" and "There Is Enough For Everyone" have now reached cult status and The Starseeds are the most sought after artist from the Millennium catalogue.

Another exciting signing followed in 1999 with the Guildford based Band Surge whom Kris Needs rated as the most original and inspiring act he had heard in years.

One of the most exciting collaborations of Millenium Records' time was born when ex-Associates front man Billy McKenzie released his comeback "Loom", featuring Billy McKenzie's "Anacostia Bay". His incredible vocal performance (which has influenced artists such as Bono of U2) over Loom's electronic soundscapes was one of the highlights of 1999 and accentuated the label's versatile love of a wide range of music.

Having reached the year 2003, Millennium Records is now being represented in eighteen European countries as well as the USA and Japan.

RecordLabel.LabelDescription:
Spankology Digital is a record label specializing in Suomisaundi and Psychedelic Trance. It was founded in 2006 by Jenni VIrtanen (a.k.a. Jennifer Current).Jennifer Current is a Finnish-American music producer, DJ, and label owner. She is best known for her work in the Suomisaundi and Psychedelic Trance genres. She has released music on numerous labels, including Spankology Digital, which she founded in 2006.

Jennifer's musical career began in the early 2000s, when she started DJing and producing music in the Finnish underground club scene. She soon began releasing music on various underground labels, and her tracks began to gain attention from DJs and producers all over the world. In 2006, she founded Spankology Digital, a label specializing in Suomisaundi and Psychedelic Trance. Since then, she has released numerous singles and albums on the label, and her music has been featured on compilations and radio shows all over the world. Jennifer is currently based in Helsinki, Finland.

RecordLabel.Name: Stoned Mursu Goa Division
RecordLabel.LabelLaunchMessage: LIlith and KolmioSilmäKulmio have started a new record label under the Stoned Mursu label group. This new label, Stoned Mursu Goa Divison, is dedicated to bringing back the goa trance sound from the 90's with a suomisaundi twist. Releases will be digital only, as per the modern trend.
RecordLabel.LabelDescription:
Stoned Mursu Goa Division is a dynamic and innovative record label, specializing in the vibrant and hypnotic sounds of Goa trance. Based in Finland, this label is home to some of the most cutting-edge electronic artists in the scene, known for their signature blend of atmospheric melodies, pulsing beats, and mind-bending sonic textures.

Stoned Mursu Goa Division is deeply committed to pushing the boundaries of Goa trance and bringing this music to new audiences around the world. With a focus on quality production, artistic integrity, and genre-defying experimentation, this label has quickly established itself as a force to be reckoned with in the global electronic music community.

At Stoned Mursu Goa Division, the emphasis is on cultivating a strong sense of community among artists, fans, and industry professionals alike. Through their dynamic and engaging social media presence, as well as their regular live events and releases, the label is dedicated to fostering a vibrant and inclusive scene where creativity, collaboration, and mutual support are the norm.

Whether you're an established fan of Goa trance or a newcomer to the scene, Stoned Mursu Goa Division is a label you won't want to miss. With their infectious energy, cutting-edge sound, and unwavering commitment to quality and community, they're sure to leave a lasting impression on anyone who experiences their music.
